## Transport policy and house prices in London

This project investigates how transport policies affect house prices in London. It uses HM Land Registry Price Paid data for 2016 to 2025, with postcodes located using ONS data. The first stage is exploratory. It asks where prices have pulled ahead of or fallen behind the rest of London. Policy (causal) analyses will follow.

1. [Which London outcodes have outpaced the rest of London?](3_portfolio/london-house-prices/05_all_outcodes.html){target="_blank"}
2. [A spatial analysis of the outcodes](3_portfolio/london-house-prices/07_outcode_maps.html){target="_blank"}
3. [Choosing inference procedures (methods)](3_portfolio/london-house-prices/06_placebo_inference.html){target="_blank"}

## Structural models

I have learned, applied and developed a range of structural models during my research and training. Most remain unpublished, as they do not fit my available data or I have yet to find suitable data. This project hosts them as a record of my work and for dissemination.
